hooks.user-prompt-submit:
#!/bin/bash
# Auto-select agents based on message content
message="$CLAUDE_USER_MESSAGE"

# Performance optimization keywords
if [[ "$message" =~ (performance|slow|optimize|speed|bottleneck|cache|lag) ]]; then
  echo 'Use performance-optimizer agent for this task'
# Database keywords
elif [[ "$message" =~ (database|query|sql|schema|postgres|supabase|db) ]]; then
  echo 'Use database-performance-specialist agent for this task'
# UI/Design keywords
elif [[ "$message" =~ (design|ui|ux|interface|visual|premium|animations|styling) ]]; then
  echo 'Use premium-ui-designer agent for this task'
# UX Flow keywords
elif [[ "$message" =~ (workflow|flow|user.*experience|navigation|simplify|friction) ]]; then
  echo 'Use ux-flow-simplifier agent for this task'
fi
